name: Soyuz TMA-07M
about: Soyuz TMA-07M (2012-074A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMM), launched 2012 Dec 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2012 Dec 20), held fixed
docked to A07725; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
